findings.title: Delay Penalties
findings.deviation: 12.2 Should the Service Provider fail to achieve any Milestone by its scheduled completion date, the Service Provider shall pay to the Company, by way of liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the Contract Value for each week or part thereof of delay. 12.3 The aggregate liquidated damages payable under this Clause 12 shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the Contract Value.
findings.impact: The delay penalties are lower than the playbook's recommendation of 0.5% per week capped at 5% of the milestone fee. This may be less effective in incentivizing timely performance.
findings.clauseRef: pb-ld: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; no LDs where the delay is caused by the client; LDs are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

fine.note: Payment terms: Invoices payable within 60 days of receipt; 60 days is the negotiated maximum.

Limitation of liability: Each party's aggregate liability capped at 1× fees (paid or payable in the prior 12 months), mutual; carve-outs only for fraud, wilful misconduct and confidentiality (plus any carve-outs that are mandatory under the governing law, e.g. German law for intent/gross negligence and injury).

Indemnity: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence; indemnities subject to the liability cap (IP infringement excepted).

Intellectual property: The client owns what AtliQ builds specifically for it (on payment); AtliQ keeps its background IP, pre-existing tools and know-how and grants a licence to use them as part of the deliverables.

Data protection & regulated data: DPA (EU) or BAA (US health) signed before any personal/regulated data moves, with a sub-DPA / sub-BAA for every party that touches the data (incl. AtliQ's own Pune entity); engagement-specific scope; offshore access only as the agreement allows.

Termination: On any termination for convenience AtliQ is paid for all work done, including work in progress. Notice is mutual. Client contracts: reasonable notice (typically 30+ days). Freelancer / vendor agreements: a mutual short exit (about 15 days, as with Rohan Iyer) is AtliQ's standard and fair to both sides.
Insurance: Check every required insurance type and limit against what AtliQ actually holds before signing (known: cyber $1M; everything else unrecorded).
